chapterInfo.content:
30
Bɔhyɛ ho mmara
1Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no so atitire sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ: 2#Lew 27.2-25; Deut 23.21; Ate 11.35; Skf 5.4-5 Sɛ obi hyɛ AWURADE bɔ anaasɛ ɔka ntam tua ne kra adeɛ bi a, ɔmmmu n’asɛm so; deɛ ɛfiri n’anomu nyinaa, ɔnyɛ.
3Na sɛ ɔbaa bi hyɛ AWURADE bɔ de tua ne ho biribi berɛ a ɔda so wɔ n’agya fie, ne mmabaaberɛ mu, 4na n’agya te ne bɔhyɛ no ne n’ahotua a ɔde tua ne kra biribie no, na n’agya anka ho biribi a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ ne n’ahotua a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no gyina hɔ. 5Na sɛ da a n’agya teɛ no wampene a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa ne n’ahotua a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no rennyina hɔ. Na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ n’agya ampene.
6Na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima yere, na ne bɔhyɛ anaa deɛ afiri n’anomu a ɔde atua ne kra biribie no da ne so, 7na ne kunu te, na da a ɔteɛ no ɔyɛ komm a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ no gyina hɔ, na tua a ɔde atua ne kra biribie no gyina hɔ. 8Na sɛ da a ne kunu teɛ no, wampene a, na wasane ne bɔhyɛ a ɛda ne soɔ ne deɛ ɛfirii n’anomu a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no, na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no.
9Na ɔbaa kunafoɔ anaa deɛ wɔako no bɔhyɛ deɛ, adeɛ biara a ɔtua ne kra no da ne so. 10Na sɛ ne kunu fie na ɔhyɛ bɔ anaasɛ ɔde ntam tua ne kra biribi, 11na ne kunu te, na ɔyɛ komm, na wammara no a, ne bɔhyɛ no nyinaa gyina hɔ, na adeɛ biara a watua ne kra no gyina hɔ. 12Nanso sɛ ne kunu sane no da a ɔteeɛ no a, ɛnneɛ adeɛ biara a afiri n’anomu a ɔde hyɛɛ bɔ anaasɛ ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no rennyina hɔ; ne kunu asane, na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no. 13Bɔhyɛ nyinaa ne ahotua ntam a wɔde brɛ ɔkra ase nyinaa, ne kunu na ɔmma no nnyina hɔ na ne kunu na ɔnsane; 14na sɛ daa ne kunu no nnka ho hwee a, ɛnneɛ ɔhyɛ ne bɔhyɛ no nyinaa anaa n’ahotua no nyinaa mu den, ɛfiri sɛ da a ɔteeɛ no, wanka ho hwee; 15na sɛ ɔteeɛ no akyi ansa na ɔresane a, ɛnneɛ ɔsoa ne yere amumuyɛ. 16Yeinom ne ahyɛdeɛ a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose sɛ ɛnna ɔbarima ne ne yere ntam, ɛne agya ne ne babaa a ɔwɔ ne mmabaaberɛ mu, n’agya fie, ntam.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ mmusuakuo no so atitire sɛ: Yei ne asɛm a AWURADE ahyɛ: Sɛ obi hyɛ AWURADE bɔ anaasɛ ɔka ntam tua ne kra adeɛ bi a, ɔmmmu n’asɛm so; deɛ ɛfiri n’anomu nyinaa, ɔnyɛ.
Na sɛ ɔbaa bi hyɛ AWURADE bɔ de tua ne ho biribi berɛ a ɔda so wɔ n’agya fie, ne mmabaaberɛ mu, na n’agya te ne bɔhyɛ no ne n’ahotua a ɔde tua ne kra biribie no, na n’agya anka ho biribi a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ ne n’ahotua a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no gyina hɔ. Na sɛ da a n’agya teɛ no wampene a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ nyinaa ne n’ahotua a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no rennyina hɔ. Na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ n’agya ampene.
Na sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima yere, na ne bɔhyɛ anaa deɛ afiri n’anomu a ɔde atua ne kra biribie no da ne so, na ne kunu te, na da a ɔteɛ no ɔyɛ komm a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔhyɛ no gyina hɔ, na tua a ɔde atua ne kra biribie no gyina hɔ. Na sɛ da a ne kunu teɛ no, wampene a, na wasane ne bɔhyɛ a ɛda ne soɔ ne deɛ ɛfirii n’anomu a ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no, na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no.
Na ɔbaa kunafoɔ anaa deɛ wɔako no bɔhyɛ deɛ, adeɛ biara a ɔtua ne kra no da ne so. Na sɛ ne kunu fie na ɔhyɛ bɔ anaasɛ ɔde ntam tua ne kra biribi, na ne kunu te, na ɔyɛ komm, na wammara no a, ne bɔhyɛ no nyinaa gyina hɔ, na adeɛ biara a watua ne kra no gyina hɔ. Nanso sɛ ne kunu sane no da a ɔteeɛ no a, ɛnneɛ adeɛ biara a afiri n’anomu a ɔde hyɛɛ bɔ anaasɛ ɔde tuaa ne kra biribie no rennyina hɔ; ne kunu asane, na AWURADE de bɛkyɛ no. Bɔhyɛ nyinaa ne ahotua ntam a wɔde brɛ ɔkra ase nyinaa, ne kunu na ɔmma no nnyina hɔ na ne kunu na ɔnsane; na sɛ daa ne kunu no nnka ho hwee a, ɛnneɛ ɔhyɛ ne bɔhyɛ no nyinaa anaa n’ahotua no nyinaa mu den, ɛfiri sɛ da a ɔteeɛ no, wanka ho hwee; na sɛ ɔteeɛ no akyi ansa na ɔresane a, ɛnneɛ ɔsoa ne yere amumuyɛ. Yeinom ne ahyɛdeɛ a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose sɛ ɛnna ɔbarima ne ne yere ntam, ɛne agya ne ne babaa a ɔwɔ ne mmabaaberɛ mu, n’agya fie, ntam.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
